metadata.description: The serial-build harness: build a product one owner-accepted gate at a time, with a red lane that tries to break each gate before it ships.

plugins.name: serial-build
plugins.description: Scope a project by interview, plan each gate on plan mode with an adversarial reviewer, slot findings in without ad-hoc edits, break every gate with a fresh red-lane agent, and hand off only what the product owner ran and accepted. Hooks are silent outside projects that opt in.
